name: cursor-usage
description: Your Cursor spend, pace and biggest costs, inside the editor.

cursorUsage.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Cursor Usage API.

cursorUsage.refreshMinutes.description: How often to refresh, in minutes.

cursorUsage.notifications.description: Show alerts when your pace or spend crosses a threshold.

enumDescriptions: microsoft when the entra settings are filled in, oidc when the oidc settings are, otherwise none
No sign-in: the API runs in dev mode
The Microsoft sign-in built into the editor (Entra ID)
Any OpenID Connect provider, signing in with a code in the browser (device code)
cursorUsage.auth.provider.description: How to sign in to the Cursor Usage API.

cursorUsage.entra.clientId.description: Entra client (app) ID used to sign in (microsoft sign-in).

cursorUsage.oidc.issuer.description: OpenID Connect issuer URL, e.g. https://example.okta.com/oauth2/default (oidc sign-in).

cursorUsage.oidc.clientId.description: Client ID of a public app with the device authorization grant turned on (oidc sign-in).

cursorUsage.oidc.scopes.description: Scopes to ask for, space-separated. offline_access gives a refresh token on most providers; leave it out for Google.

cursorUsage.oidc.audience.description: Audience to ask for, for providers that need one to issue a JWT access token (Auth0). Usually empty.

cursorUsage.oidc.tokenType.description: Which token to send to the API: the access token, or the ID token for providers whose access tokens aren't JWTs (Google).

cursorUsage.oidc.clientSecret.description: Only for providers that require one for device sign-in even though it isn't secret (Google's 'TVs and limited input' clients). Leave empty otherwise.

scripts.package: npm run compile && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --skip-license -o dist/
